inputs.commit_message: Implement Gova direct P2P agent execution plan end to end
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
PROMPT=$(cat <<'EOF'
You are the single implementation agent responsible for completing the entire plan in note/gova-direct-p2p-agent-execution-plan.md on the real Gova host. Execute it fully end-to-end now; do not stop at analysis, design, or a partial scaffold. Read the current repository rules and all relevant docs first, then inspect the actual local-agent-core, Host Discovery, gateway, R2 publishing, runner and host-control implementations and adapt the plan to the current architecture.

Required outcome: GitHub is bootstrap authorization only; R2 is discovery/rendezvous metadata only; after bootstrap, normal agent operations use a secure direct encrypted transport independent of GitHub Actions; Host Discovery remains discovery-only; execution reuses @asol/local-agent-core and preserves locks, worktrees, stale-lock recovery, replay prevention, memory admission, operation logs, mutation serialization, timeouts, secret redaction and full repository safety. Implement the protocol/domain, host identity, short-lived sessions, capability checks, replay cache, bootstrap watcher/validation on agent-request/chatgpt without workflow_dispatch, direct server daemon, direct client, discovery v2, publication cadence, session management/revocation/key rotation commands, closed typed operations, streaming/bounds, NAT candidate collection and direct/P2P connectivity probes. Prefer a stable standard encrypted transport supported by the real Node/runtime; if QUIC is not sufficiently stable in this repository/runtime, choose the safest maintained alternative (for example WebRTC DataChannel or TLS 1.3 over TCP) and document the evidence and tradeoff. Do not invent custom cryptography. Do not reintroduce or depend on the removed p2p-link repository.

Use the real local host where required. Create machine-local identity/session state only under ignored .local paths with strict permissions. Install and enable the required user systemd service/timer/watcher on this host, using existing local host patterns. Publish discovery often enough for its TTL, not hourly. Perform real loopback/LAN/network/NAT/STUN reachability checks that are possible on this machine, and verify the service is running. Never print or export secret values. Do not expose the existing Host Discovery password as command authorization.

Implement all plan acceptance criteria that are achievable from the repository and host. A remote ChatGPT product-side raw socket/tool cannot be manufactured from inside this repository; for that boundary, implement and fully test the vendor-neutral client/protocol/tool-ready surface so an external connector can call it, and record only that external platform integration as a residual dependency if it truly cannot be completed locally. Do not leave any repository/host work undone merely because that final external connector is outside this machine.

Add comprehensive tests including protocol validation, crypto/session lifecycle, authorization freshness and replay rejection, capability denial, redaction, request/output limits, discovery v2, client-server integration, daemon lifecycle, key/session CLI operations, NAT candidate logic and regression tests ensuring Host Discovery never becomes an exec endpoint. Update current project documentation in English under docs/ and generate any required catalogs. Create note/gova-direct-p2p-agent-execution-result.md with the final architecture, exact files/commands, machine-local service state, tests run, live checks, security properties, and any genuinely external residual limitation.

Run the relevant focused tests plus global typecheck, lint, architecture checks and documentation checks; fix failures rather than documenting them away. Preserve unrelated project work. When the implementation and host setup are verified, commit all tracked changes directly to main with a clear commit message, push origin main, and ensure /home/hesham/gova ends on branch main, clean, with HEAD exactly equal to origin/main before you exit. The surrounding canonical-host workflow will reject you if tracked changes remain. Do not ask the user questions; make reasonable secure decisions and continue until the plan is complete.
EOF
)
agy --dangerously-skip-permissions -p "$PROMPT"
git fetch --prune origin main
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
